text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate 6. Family Finance Support Photocopy of the financial support statement with signature 7. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.
